# MNEMO

> Your AI's memory, sealed on chain. Notes are encrypted in the browser with a key only the owner's
> wallet can derive, stored on Ethereum as ciphertext in MnemoVault events, and loaded into any model.

Addresses, chain, ABIs and public RPCs: ./imd-deployment.json (contracts "MnemoVault" and
"LaunchToken", ABIs at the listed abiPath). Every note sealed burns the vault's current `stamp()` in
MNEMO (2,000 at launch), pulled from the writer with transferFrom, so approve the vault first.

## Contract (MnemoVault)
- write(bytes[] notes, uint32 epoch): seal 1 to 16 notes, each 1 to 2,048 bytes, into your own vault.
  `epoch` must equal epochOf(you).
- writeFor(address owner, bytes[] notes, uint32 epoch): the same, as an agent the owner granted;
  the agent pays the stamp. `epoch` must equal epochOf(owner).
- forget(uint256[] ids), rotate(), grant(address agent, bytes sealedKey), revoke(address agent)
  (revoke also rotates the owner's epoch), register(bytes32 x25519PublicKey).
- Views: epochOf, isGranted, keyOf, noteOwnerOf, stamp, notesTotal, burnedTotal.
- Events: Noted(owner, id, epoch, ciphertext), Forgotten(owner, id), Rotated(owner, epoch),
  Granted(owner, agent, epoch, sealedKey), Revoked(owner, agent), KeyRegistered(account, key).

## Keys and ciphertext
All HKDF is HKDF-SHA256 with 32-byte output. Signatures are EIP-191 personal_sign by an EOA
(deterministic RFC 6979); the address in each message is the EIP-55 checksummed address.

- Vault key for epoch e: HKDF(ikm = signature bytes of "MNEMO vault key v1 for {address}",
  salt = "MNEMO", info = "vault:{e}").
- Note: 0x01 | nonce (24 random bytes) | XChaCha20-Poly1305(vault key, nonce, UTF-8 text).
  Plaintext is at most 2,007 bytes so the note fits 2,048.
- Agent secret (x25519): HKDF(ikm = signature bytes of "MNEMO agent key v1 for {address}",
  salt = "MNEMO", info = "agent"). register() publishes its x25519 public key.
- Sealed key in grant(): 0x01 | ephemeral x25519 public key (32) | nonce (24) |
  XChaCha20-Poly1305(K, nonce, vault key for the owner's current epoch), where
  K = HKDF(ikm = x25519(ephemeral secret, agent public), salt = ephemeral public | agent public,
  info = "MNEMO grant v1").

## Reading a vault as an agent
1. Find the latest Granted(owner, you) whose epoch equals epochOf(owner); open sealedKey.
2. Read Noted(owner) logs from the vault's deployment block, skip ids in Forgotten(owner), and
   decrypt those whose epoch matches. Notes from other epochs need that epoch's key.
3. To write, approve the vault for the stamp, seal with the same key and call writeFor.

A 37-line Node script that does all of this: ./mnemo-agent.mjs

## Privacy
The site has no backend and no analytics. Chat requests go from the browser straight to the provider
the user picks. Nothing about other wallets is listed; the site shows network totals only.
